data.name: Ara
data.gender_notes: Ara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ara is derived from the Arabic root ‘ar-r-a’, meaning a lofty mountain, majestic and powerful. It is a name that symbolizes strength and resilience, reminding us of the might of God's creations. The name Ara carries the meaning “Mountain of majesty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ara usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain of majesty and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني العالية أو العظيمة في الشأن
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عربي مؤنث، مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ع-ر-ى، والذي يدل على الارتفاع والعلو في الشأن. يستخدم في بعض الأحيان كاسم للبنات، ويعبر عن العالية أو العظيمة في الشأن. وقد ورد في بعض المصادر أنه يعني السمو والرفعة.

in_urdu.name: عارا
in_urdu.meaning: عظیم شان والی، بلند کردار، عالیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی मूल کا اسم، جو ع-ر-ى جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بلند یا عظیم شان والا۔ یہ نام اکثر اس کے صوفیاتی اور روحانی معنی کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، جو اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: आरा नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है आदरणीय या सम्मानित। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रचलित है, जहां इसे उच्च चरित्र वाली या महान आत्मा वाली लड़की के लिए चुना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عاره
in_pashto.meaning: د عظیمو خلقو په منځ کې لوړه شوې
in_pashto.long_meaning: عربۍ ريښې لرونکی نوم، چې معنی یې د ع-ر-ى جذر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، لوړ یا عظیم شان لرونکی. په افغان کلتور کې، دا نوم د لوړ مقام یا ښه شهرت لرونکې نجلې لپاره کارول کیږي.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ara has a grandiose and regal feel that is deeply rooted in Islamic culture. Its connection to majestic and powerful mountains evokes images of the mountains Sacred to Islam: Mount Sinai, where Moses received the Ten Commandments, and Mount Hirkal, where ancient arab idolaters used to worship. Ara, as a name, carries with it a sense of nobility and honor, inspiring those who bear it to strive for excellence and stature in their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ara is a reminder of the strength and resilience that comes from faith in God. Just as mountains stand strong and unwavering, so too should our faith in Allah be steadfast and unyielding. The name evokes images of the powerful and majestic nature of God, reminding us of His infinite power and mercy. As we face the challenges and trials of life, the name Ara serves as a reminder to draw strength and inspiration from the unwavering and enduring nature of the mountains and our faith in Allah.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's Muqaddimah mentions a Berber tribe called the Arawas or Ara, who were influential in the Maghreb during the Middle Ages and contributed significantly to Islamic scholarship.

The Ara were also mentioned in the works of the 14th century Andalusian scholar Ibn Idhari, who described them as a Berber tribe that inhabited the region between the Oranais and the Djurdjura Mountains in present-day Algeria, and were known for their bravery and military prowess.
